characters.name: Washerwoman
characters.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
characters.storytellerNotes: FIRST NIGHT ONLY. Show two players and a Townsfolk token (one is correct). Place Townsfolk + Wrong · Washerwoman reminders. Does not wake again.

characters.name: Librarian
characters.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
characters.storytellerNotes: FIRST NIGHT ONLY. Show two players and an Outsider (or that zero Outsiders are in play). Does not wake again.

characters.name: Investigator
characters.ability: You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
characters.storytellerNotes: FIRST NIGHT ONLY. Show two players and a Minion token. Does not wake again.

characters.name: Chef
characters.ability: You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
characters.storytellerNotes: FIRST NIGHT ONLY. Show fingers for evil neighbor pairs. Does not wake again.

characters.name: Empath
characters.ability: Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
characters.storytellerNotes: Every night. Count evil among two alive neighbors (skip dead). Drunk/poisoned may get false info.

characters.name: Fortune Teller
characters.ability: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
characters.storytellerNotes: Every night. They pick two; nod if either is Demon OR the red herring. Place Red herring reminder on a good player at setup.

characters.name: Undertaker
characters.ability: Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
characters.storytellerNotes: OTHER NIGHTS ONLY, and ONLY if someone was executed today. Show that character token. Skip if no execution. Clear Died today at dawn.

characters.name: Monk
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
characters.storytellerNotes: OTHER NIGHTS ONLY. They choose a player; place Safe. Imp cannot kill that player tonight.

characters.name: Ravenkeeper
characters.ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
characters.storytellerNotes: ONLY if they died tonight (before this step). Wake them; they pick a player; show that character. Skip if alive or died by execution/day.

characters.name: Virgin
characters.ability: The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
characters.storytellerNotes: DAY ability (no night wake). First nomination only: if nominator is Townsfolk, execute nominator immediately, no vote. Then mark ability used / No ability.

characters.name: Slayer
characters.ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
characters.storytellerNotes: DAY ability, ONCE PER GAME. Public claim; if target is Demon they die. Mark ability used. Drunk/poisoned Slayer fails.

characters.name: Soldier
characters.ability: You are safe from the Demon.
characters.storytellerNotes: Passive — no wake. Imp cannot kill them at night. Still die by execution etc.

characters.name: Mayor
characters.ability: If only 3 players live & no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
characters.storytellerNotes: Passive — no wake. Check 3-alive no-execution win at dusk. Night death may bounce to someone else (ST choice).

characters.name: Butler
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
characters.storytellerNotes: Every night. They choose Master; place reminder. Next day they may only vote if Master is voting.

characters.name: Drunk
characters.ability: You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
characters.storytellerNotes: No Drunk wake. Set their character to Drunk and pick the Townsfolk they think they are (not one in play) — or put that Townsfolk on them and toggle Is the Drunk. They wake as that Townsfolk and get false-able info; everything that learns true characters (Undertaker, Ravenkeeper, Librarian, end reveal) sees the Drunk.

characters.name: Recluse
characters.ability: You might register as evil & as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
characters.storytellerNotes: Passive — no wake. May register evil to Empath, FT, Spy, etc. ST decides when.

characters.name: Saint
characters.ability: If you die by execution, your team loses.
characters.storytellerNotes: Passive — no wake. If executed, evil wins immediately.

characters.name: Poisoner
characters.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
characters.storytellerNotes: Every night (incl. first). Choose player; Poisoned reminder. Clear previous poison when they pick anew.

characters.name: Spy
characters.ability: Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good & as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
characters.storytellerNotes: Every night. Show the full grimoire. May register as good to abilities.

characters.name: Scarlet Woman
characters.ability: If there are 5 or more players alive & the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers don't count.)
characters.storytellerNotes: OTHER NIGHTS. Usually no action unless Demon died today/tonight with ≥5 non-Traveller alive — then they become Imp. Travellers do not count toward 5.

characters.name: Baron
characters.ability: There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
characters.storytellerNotes: SETUP only — no wake. Add +2 Outsiders (−2 Townsfolk) during bag setup.

characters.name: Imp
characters.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Demon.
characters.storytellerNotes: OTHER NIGHTS ONLY (first night = Demon info only). Choose kill; mark Dead. If Imp self-kills, a Minion becomes Imp (Scarlet Woman if eligible).

travellers.name: Beggar
travellers.ability: You must use a vote token to vote. If a dead player gives you theirs, you learn their alignment. You are sober and healthy.
travellers.storytellerNotes: Traveller. Only a dead player with an unused vote token can give one (Travel tab → Give vote token; you learn their alignment privately). Each Beggar vote spends a token. Exile instead of execute; does not count for the Scarlet Woman's 5.

travellers.name: Bureaucrat
travellers.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
travellers.storytellerNotes: Traveller night ability. Place 3 votes reminder. The token lapses if the Bureaucrat dies (including exile).

travellers.name: Thief
travellers.ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
travellers.storytellerNotes: Traveller night ability. The token lapses immediately if the Thief dies (including exile).

travellers.name: Gunslinger
travellers.ability: Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
travellers.storytellerNotes: DAY ability each day after first vote tallied.

travellers.name: Scapegoat
travellers.ability: If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
travellers.storytellerNotes: Your choice at execution (Votes tab → execute the Scapegoat instead). Still counts as today's execution; the Undertaker sees the Scapegoat.

travellers.name: Apprentice
travellers.ability: On your 1st night, you gain a Townsfolk ability (if good) or a Minion ability (if evil).
travellers.storytellerNotes: FIRST NIGHT with this Traveller only. Show them an ability; they have it from then on.

travellers.name: Matron
travellers.ability: Each day, you may choose up to 3 sets of 2 players to swap seats. Players may not leave their seats to talk in private.
travellers.storytellerNotes: DAY ability. Use Grimoire → Move seat to match the swaps (seat order drives Empath / Chef / vote order).

travellers.name: Judge
travellers.ability: Once per game, if another player nominated, you may choose to force the current execution to pass or fail.

travellers.name: Voudon
travellers.ability: Only you & the dead can vote. They don't need a vote token to do so. A 50% majority isn't required.
travellers.storytellerNotes: Changes voting rules while in play.

travellers.name: Bishop
travellers.ability: Only the Storyteller can nominate. At least 1 opposing player must be nominated each day.
travellers.storytellerNotes: Changes nomination rules while in play.

fabled.name: Angel
fabled.ability: Something bad might happen to whoever is most responsible for the death of a new player.

fabled.name: Buddhist
fabled.ability: For the first 2 days, minions get false Info.

fabled.name: Djinn
fabled.ability: Use the Djinn's special rules. [depends on script]

fabled.name: Fibbin
fabled.ability: Once per game, 1 good player might get incorrect information.

fabled.name: Fiddler
fabled.ability: Once per game, the Demon secretly chooses an opposing player: all players vote which of those 2 win the game.

fabled.name: Hell's Librarian
fabled.ability: Something bad might happen to whoever talks when the Storyteller asks for silence.

fabled.name: Revolutionary
fabled.ability: 2 neighboring players are known to be the same alignment. Once per game, 1 of them registers falsely.

fabled.name: Storm Catcher
fabled.ability: Name a good character. If in play, they can only die by execution, but evil knows who they are.

fabled.name: Doomsayer
fabled.ability: If 4 or more players live, each living player may publicly choose (once per game) that a player of their own alignment dies.

firstNightMeta.name: Dusk
firstNightMeta.wakeText: Wait for everyone to close their eyes. Night begins.

firstNightMeta.name: Minion info
firstNightMeta.wakeText: 7+ players only. Wake all the Minions. Show them the Demon (they see each other). Put them to sleep.

firstNightMeta.name: Demon info
firstNightMeta.wakeText: 7+ players only. Wake the Demon. Show the Minions. Show three bluffs. Put the Demon to sleep. (Imp does not kill on night one.)

otherNightMeta.name: Dusk
otherNightMeta.wakeText: Wait for everyone to close their eyes. Night begins. Clear expired night reminders as needed.
